fields.author: Michael A. Mandell
fields.title: E-infinity algebras and p-adic homotopy theory
fields.annote: Author full47-page version downloaded. Main Theorem authorp1: connected p-complete nilpotent finite p-type spaces embed fully contravariantly using E-infinity cochains over algebraic closure of F_p. AppendixA TheoremsA.1--A.2 authorp35 distinguish fields with surjective1-F and finite fields, where maps involve free loop spaces. Not the integral2006 theorem. fields.annote: Original article opened and exact axioms/theorems read. Main Theorem p.548 characterizes E-infinity cochain theories satisfying homotopy, excision, disjoint-union/product and dimension axioms. Uniqueness Theorem p.549 gives only identity endomorphism in the localized functor category. This is a different, enhanced category from the manuscript’s bigraded PD theories. Received11December2000, revised24September2001.

fields.author: Michael A. Mandell
fields.title: Cochains and homotopy type
fields.annote: Original source opened by root; Main Theorem p.213 and Theorem0.1 p.214 matched. Integral E-infinity cochains classify finite-type nilpotent spaces; functor is faithful and not full. First arXiv3November2003; online publication28June2006. Separate from Mandell2001 and2002.

fields.author: Torsten Ekedahl
fields.title: On minimal models in integral homotopy theory
fields.annote: Original arXiv source opened and exact Lemma2.8 p.6, Theorem2.9 pp.6--7 read (published numbering Theorem2.7). Connected nilpotent spaces with degreewise finitely generated homology admit minimal special numerical models, unique up to numerical homotopy, not strict isomorphism. Numerical maps are integer-valued rational polynomial maps. First30June2001, revised20August2001, publication2002.

fields.author: Bertrand Toën
fields.title: Le problème de la schématisation de Grothendieck revisité

Theorem0.1 pp.2--3 gives retraction on integer points and faithfulness/object injectivity; §5 p.13 says not full. First arXiv13November2019, publication2020. No equivalence with manuscript coPD category proved.

fields.title: Binomial rings and homotopy theory

First arXiv4November2022; journal2024; currently opened revised author version23March2025 is distinguished from journal pagination.

fields.author: Birgit Richter and Steffen Sagave
fields.title: A strictly commutative model for the cochain algebra of a space
fields.annote: Original publisher PDF opened. Theorem1.2 p.1720 classifies nilpotent finite-type spaces over Z. §1.4 p.1722 records failure of fullness. First arXivJanuary2018; precise day not asserted here.

fields.author: Tom Bachmann and Robert Burklund
fields.title: E-infinity-coalgebras and p-adic homotopy theory
fields.annote: Published30-page source downloaded and exact Theorems1.2/8.1,1.3/8.2 inspected. Over a separably closed field of characteristic p, E-infinity coalgebra chains are fully faithful on p-complete nilpotent spaces without finite-type or connectedness assumptions. Simply connected essential image requires connective π0=k,π1=0 and solvable higher homotopy under the published Verschiebung operation. No identification with coPD coalgebras in the manuscript. First arXiv24February2024; received27June2025, accepted15December2025, published23March2026.
